findings.summary: The fragment says the deliberate negative control makes the committed classifier fail 'four' of the focused tests, while the negative-control log it points to lists five failing ids and a '5 failed, 10 passed' summary at EXIT=1, and the source manifest also says five. The control is stronger than the text claims, but a tracked evidence document that misstates its own gate by one is checkable only against the log it cites.

select_hand_sample re-implements deterministic seeded stratified sampling that already exists privately as imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:283 (_stratified_sample, round-robin buckets under random.Random seeded shuffle) and imas_codex/standard_names/judgment_goldens.py:117 (_sample, round-robin buckets ordered by a rank). Neither is a shared owner and both are private to the standard-names benchmark, and the new draw is materially stronger (per-identity hash ranking, so input order cannot change the sample), so this is not a fork of an owned capability; recorded so that a future sampler gets one owner rather than a third copy.

justifications.durability: The recorded negative control reddens five ids including tests/discovery/test_category_codes.py:30, and the second commit's eligibility change is guarded by the ValueError leg of tests/discovery/test_category_codes.py:123-128, so a regression to link_count makes size=2 selectable somewhere and reddens the raises assertions.
justifications.evidence: The gate at tests/discovery/test_category_codes.py reproduced 15 passed at head in this review, and the private summary.json matches the fragment, but the reviewed run armed no baseline arm and the published counts rest on a private one-off script (measure.py) that no tracked test executes.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/discovery/signals/category_codes.py:1-19 follows the module style of imas_codex/discovery/signals/variable_names.py, frozen dataclass and pure functions, and no name is a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/codac-uda-signals/measure-category-names-against-plant-codes.html reports every quantity the plan asks for, and imas_codex/discovery/signals/category_codes.py:56-84 only classifies, so nothing is linked.
justifications.reuse: Search over imas_codex/ for sampling and delimited matching found no shared owner; the nearest samplers are the private standard-names helpers named in the finding, and delimited_parts has no precedent.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat f77dd1120 bf4de0896 lists four files, all inside the declared write paths, and the fragment states zero links written and zero search behaviour changed.
